description: [WRITE] Create a GTM variable. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true and confirm=true.

parameter.description: GTM parameter list — supports NESTED list/map params. Example (a GA4 event parameter table): [{"type":"list","key":"eventSettingsTable","list":[{"type":"map","map":[{"type":"template","key":"parameter","value":"click_text"},{"type":"template","key":"parameterValue","value":"{{Click Text}}"}]}]}].

key.description: Parameter key/name (omit for entries inside a list).

type.description: template | integer | boolean | list | map | tagReference | triggerReference | template

value.description: Scalar value (template/integer/boolean/reference). May be a GTM variable like {{Click Text}}.

type.description: Variable type (e.g. "v" for data layer, "k" for first-party cookie, "u" for URL, "c" for constant, "jsm" for custom JS, "smm" for lookup table, "gas" for GA settings).

name: variables_create
